caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular wooden block with three carved recesses on its upper surface. There are two circular wells positioned side by side along the front edge of the block, and a single elongated oval recess located behind them, running parallel to the longer side of the rectangle. The block is rendered in shades of brown, with subtle gradients suggesting wood grain and edges. The recesses are shaded to indicate depth, with the two circular wells having a slightly grayish tone inside, contrasting with the brown outer surface. The background is plain and off-white, and there is a small text signature on the lower right corner.
title: Writing Desk Set
